intro.text: A nation whose people are ethnically JinDo. Now part of the Fjordell Empire, it has Shu-Dereth as its official religion.

description.text: Landlocked, it borders JinDo to the west, Fjorden to the north, Hraggen and Hrovell to the east, with a broad desert along its south. Kjaard, one of its cities, stands on a river close to the Fjordell border.
Jaadorian chefs rank among the finest anywhere, and the country exports blue candy and blue wine.

The jedaver, a light and elegant sword known elsewhere as a syre or kmeer, originated in Jaador. Too impractical for battle, it served nobles mainly in duels, and the Dula adapted it for fencing. Jaadorians are rated the best fencers after the Dula.
